newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP SLIP AFTER HBI PROJECT COST BLOW-OUT.
newsitem.headline: BHP SLIP AFTER HBI PROJECT COST BLOW-OUT.

text.p: The shares of Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd (BHP) opened weaker against the market on Thursday after it flagged a cost blow-out at its Pilbara hot briquetted iron (HBI) project and after the resignation of its minerals division chief Dick Carter on Wednesday.
At 10.45 a.m (0045 GMT), BHP shares were 23 cents weaker at A$17.76 defying a stronger Australian market which started firmer after a strong rally on Wall Street.
"BHP seems to be making announcements like these every other day and I think some investors are starting to wonder what else are they going to announce," a Melbourne-based dealer said.
Analysts said on Wednesday the sudden exit of Carter indicated the company could be about to make major changes to its minerals division which has underperformed other divisions in the past year.
